title: CAMP GX600 PES carbon all-road bike
notes: Current exact PES product page identifies a Toray T800 carbon frame, Toray T700 carbon fork and seatpost, internal routing, 700C x 450/480/500 mm size choices, a 700x35C fitted tire, and an approximately 9.1 kg small-size complete-bike claim excluding pedals and small accessories. It does not publish maximum tire clearance, numeric geometry, frame-only weight, bottom-bracket standard, lay-up schedule, molding process, or a meaningful stiffness test. The current official purchase page and JD route show CNY 5,688 subject to stock and delivery terms.
